laws.noSilentDeletion: A non-delete action never removes prior authored pixels or items.
laws.closedDestruction: Every destructive action is present in both the destructive registry and the manual capability registry.
laws.singleCoordinator: Enabled manual mutations authorize one registered command before entering the existing DrawingWorkspace coordinator.
laws.zeroAiExpansion: This phase adds no AI caller, provider, model, prompt, API, external request, active rig authoring, or network behavior.
